join_query.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    t1.customer_id AS customer_id,
    t2.product_id AS product_id
FROM NCC_SUBSCRIPTION t1
JOIN NCC_PRODUCT t2 ON t1.subscription_id = t2.subscription_id

join_query.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    t2.is_primary AS is_primary,
    t3.line1 AS line1,
    t1.customer_id AS customer_id
FROM BSCS_BILLING_ACCOUNT t1
JOIN BSCS_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS t2 ON t1.customer_id = t2.billing_account_id
JOIN BSCS_ADDRESS t3 ON t2.billing_account_id = t3.address_id
